item.title: Root Finding Of Functions
item.description: Numerical Techniques Root Finding Notes Tomorrow is my exam on numerical techniques and what better way to lear NT than by doing it!? Almost all of the blow methods follow the following points. To keep myself from repeating, I’ll mention them here : Given an equation \(f(x) = 0\) for which we need to find roots for Find \(a\) and \(b\) such that \(f(a)*f(b) < 0\) meaning \(f(a)\) & \(f(b)\) are of opposite signs.

Basic Memory Manager /** * @brief MemoryManager state. * */ typedef struct memory_manager_t { HashTable* buffer_map; ///< Pointer to size map. . . . } MemoryManager; MemoryManager* MemoryManagerCreate(); void MemoryManagerDestroy(MemoryManager* m); . . . Writing memory managers are a difficult task. We have two basic options. First one is that we implement a full blown Garbage Collector that can scan the entire stack and heap for possible memory regions having no reference stored anywhere anymore, other is we implement a Memory Checker that’ll check if allocated memory objects are free’d or not.

item.title: RzIL Introductory Notes
item.description: References First Some idea about how RzIL works can be found here : https://github.com/rizinorg/rizin/blob/dev/doc/rzil.md RzIL is based on BAP’s Core Theory so do read about that too. Analysis code is present in librz/include/rz_analysis.h and librz/analysis. ESIL uplifters are present in librz/analysis/p and the new RzIL uplifters are present in librz/analysis/arch. Each of these intermediate languages can be emulated so there must be a VM to interpret these ILs and run them.
